title: North-Central Development Commission (Establishment) Act, 2024
gazette_number: Federal Republic of Nigeria Official Gazette / Act No. 64 of 2024
description: An Act to establish the North-Central Development Commission charged with the responsibility among other things to receive and manage funds for the reconstruction, rehabilitation, and development of the North-Central States.

sections.section_title: Establishment of the North Central Development Commission
sections.part: Part I - Establishment of the Commission and the Governing Board
sections.full_text:
(1) There is established the North Central Development Commission (in this Act referred to as "the Commission").
(2) The Commission —
(a) is a body corporate with perpetual succession and a common seal; and
(b) may sue and be sued in its corporate name.
(3) The headquarters of the Commission shall be in Makurdi, Benue State, and the Commission may establish offices in other Member States.

sections.section_title: Resignation, cessation or removal from membership of the Board
sections.part: Part I - Establishment of the Commission and the Governing Board
sections.full_text:
(1) A member of the Board, other than an ex-officio member, may resign his appointment by notice in writing to the President, which resignation shall take effect upon receipt and approval by the President.
(2) A member of the Board may be removed from office by the President if he becomes of unsound mind, bankrupt, convicted of a felony, or guilty of serious misconduct.

sections.part: Part III - Structure of the Commission
sections.full_text:
(1) There shall be established in the headquarters of the Commission departments including Administration, Finance, Planning and Statistics, Agriculture, Solid Minerals, Environmental Services, and Legal Services.
(2) The Board may restructure or create new departments with the approval of the President.
